content.text: Done! I've fixed OPS-90 by correcting the `urgentFirst` function to sort in descending order by priority. The change was simple: reversing the sort comparator from `a.priority - b.priority` to `b.priority - a.priority` so that the highest priority entries come first, matching the acceptance criteria.
